title: Micromagnetic Nanowire Domain Wall Simulator
description: Simulated and analyzed domain wall motion in magnetic nanowires under thermal gradients, investigating shape anisotropy effects.
overview: In this project, we studied the role of shape anisotropy on thermal gradient-driven domain wall dynamics in magnetic nanowires. Using MuMax3 for micromagnetic simulations and Python for parsing spatial spin states, we mapped domain wall speeds and localized pinning behaviors. The results contributed to our publication in Modern Physics Letters B (2023).
